# Using `@pytest.mark.parametrize()`

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "test_input, expected_output",
    [
        ("input_value", "expected_out_value")
    ]
)

def test_your_function(test_input, expected_output):
    """
    Pytest will run this exact function 6 separate times, swapping out
    test_input and expected_output automatically for each case.
    """
    # Act
    actual_result = do_something(test_input)
    
    # Assert
    assert actual_result == expected_output
```
